description: Resumable tracker for the webauthn-server-buildkit v2.3.0 polish: dependency verification, full security/correctness/completeness audit + fixes, FULL attestation verification with FIDO MDS, regression tests, docs, and npm release. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on. Re-running the originating prompt MUST read this file and resume from the first non-complete sub-task — never restart from scratch.

userDecisions.attestation: FULL attestation + FIDO MDS trust anchoring for all formats (apple, fido-u2f, packed-x5c, android-key, tpm, android-safetynet/Play Integrity). Multi-session. Keep package offline-by-default and lean: in-house minimal DER reader + Node crypto.X509Certificate for chains; bundle only the small static Apple WebAuthn Root CA; expose a pluggable MetadataService/trust-anchor provider so the RP supplies the large FIDO MDS blob (no bundling/fetching at import). One small vetted ASN.1 dependency pre-approved ONLY if TPM/Android-key parsing is infeasible in-house.
userDecisions.tests: APPROVED to add regression tests for the security work + the currently-untested authentication path (overrides the standing no-tests-unless-asked rule, scoped to this work).
userDecisions.compatibility: Secure-by-default: new protections ON by default, documented as CHANGELOG upgrade notes. Provide config switches to restore legacy behavior where a default change could break existing integrations.
userDecisions.versioning: Minor 2.3.0. Document upgrade notes for behavior changes (challenge lifecycle enforcement, alg pinning at auth, crossOrigin rejection, new VerifiedAuthenticationInfo/VerifiedRegistrationInfo fields).

knownRisks: Full attestation + FIDO MDS is large; sequence simplest-first (apple -> fido-u2f -> packed-x5c -> android-key -> tpm -> android-safetynet), each independently committable.
Secure-by-default behavior changes may require existing integrations to adjust — mitigated with config switches + documented upgrade notes.
TPM/android-safetynet may need a vetted ASN.1/JWT dependency if in-house parsing is infeasible (user pre-approved one small dependency).
android-safetynet is deprecated by Google (Play Integrity successor) — implement for completeness, recommend Play Integrity in docs.
npm token previously expired — publish may need a fresh token + explicit --userconfig/always-auth (see memory npm-publish-token-expired).
commitPolicy: ONE commit per completed+verified phase (green checkpoint), tracker + progress update included in the same commit. Push after committing (authorized by project CLAUDE.md). npm publish requires explicit user confirmation at Phase 8.

phases.title: Critical security (challenge lifecycle + algorithm pinning + session hardening)

subTasks.title: SEC-N1: storage-backed challenge single-use/expiry/operation enforcement in server.ts verify wrappers (secure-by-default + config switch)
subTasks.note: Added enforceChallengeStore config (default true). New private consumeChallengeFromStore() in server.ts: find -> reject CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND if absent, CHALLENGE_OPERATION_MISMATCH if wrong op, CHALLENGE_EXPIRED if expired (deletes bad ones). verifyRegistration/verifyAuthentication now consume the challenge in a finally (delete regardless of outcome) so it can never be replayed.

subTasks.title: SEC-N2/N3: alg<->crv consistency in cose.ts; persist registered alg; enforce supportedAlgorithms + exact alg (incl. RSA padding) at authentication
subTasks.note: cose.ts: assertAlgorithmConsistent() rejects a declared alg inconsistent with kty/crv (COSE_ALG_MISMATCH) — blocks a P-256 key declaring ES512 or an RSA key declaring ES256/PSS-vs-PKCS1 swap. authentication/verify-response.ts: enforces supportedAlgorithms allowlist at auth (UNSUPPORTED_CREDENTIAL_ALGORITHM) and pins credential.alg when set (ALGORITHM_MISMATCH). WebAuthnCredential.alg + VerifiedRegistrationInfo.credential.alg added; registration now returns alg.

subTasks.title: SEC-N7: validate session-token field lengths (iv=12, tag=16, salt=32) before decipher
subTasks.note: token.ts parseSessionToken validates iv/tag/salt lengths before createDecipheriv; rejects malformed tokens with a generic SessionError.

subTasks.title: HYG-N3: re-check stored-session expiry after adapter fetch
subTasks.note: manager.ts validateSession re-validates storedSession.expiresAt after find() (defense-in-depth for custom adapters that don't filter expiry; the bundled MemoryStorageAdapter already filters in find()).

subTasks.title: Tests: auth round-trip (success), counter regression, RP-ID/origin mismatch, UV-required, bad signature, challenge single-use, alg pinning; Verify gate + commit

subTasks.title: FUNC-N1 + API-N2: read/validate userHandle; return userHandle in VerifiedAuthenticationInfo; return generated webAuthnUserID + alg from registration
subTasks.note: verifyAuthenticationResponse reads response.response.userHandle and rejects USER_HANDLE_MISMATCH when it does not equal credential.webAuthnUserID; returns userHandle in VerifiedAuthenticationInfo. createRegistrationOptions now returns webAuthnUserId (= options.user.id). alg returned in registration (Phase 2).

subTasks.note: Both verify paths reject CROSS_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED when clientData.crossOrigin===true unless allowCrossOriginIframe (new config, default false).

subTasks.note: parseCOSEPublicKey uses === undefined / instanceof Uint8Array guards + validates EC2 coord length per curve (32/48/66), RSA modulus >= 256 bytes, Ed25519 x === 32.

subTasks.title: FUNC-N5: reject unexpected trailing bytes after COSE key when ED flag unset

subTasks.title: SEC-N5/N6: surface backupStateChanged + userVerificationDowngraded + counterSupported signals

subTasks.title: FUNC-N3: origin handling incl. android:apk-key-hash + documented normalization/matcher

subTasks.title: FUNC-N6: tag CBOR/COSE errors with stable code; branch on code not message

runHistory.summary: Confirmed v2.2.0 polish complete + published. Established green baseline (166 tests). Verified all 11 deps already at latest stable. Ran fresh deep audit (general-purpose agent) finding NEW issues beyond v2.2.0's 16: SEC-N1 stored-challenge never validated (replay), SEC-N2/N3 alg not pinned at auth, SEC-N4 crossOrigin unchecked, SEC-N5 BE/BS+UV downgrade, FUNC-N1 userHandle unvalidated/undiscarded webAuthnUserID, plus correctness/API/hygiene items + a full per-format attestation spec. Confirmed 3 scope decisions with user (full attestation+MDS, tests approved, secure-by-default). Invoked skills: security-review, security-best-practices, nodejs-best-practices, vitest. Scaffolded resumable plan: overview, findings, tracker, progress, 8 phase files.

Dependency verification: confirmed all 11 deps at latest stable (no bumps needed — refreshed during v2.2.0 today). yarn install --immutable clean (no lockfile drift). No banned deps; only cbor-x in production; engine >=24.13.0, pm yarn@4.14.1 intact. Formatted the new plan files (prettier) so format:check is repo-wide clean. Gate green. Phase 0 + Phase 1 committed together as the first green checkpoint.

Critical security. SEC-N1: storage-backed challenge lifecycle — verifyRegistration/verifyAuthentication now find+validate (existence/operation/expiry) and consume-once the stored challenge (secure-by-default via enforceChallengeStore, default true; finally-delete prevents replay). SEC-N2/N3: cose.ts rejects alg inconsistent with kty/crv (COSE_ALG_MISMATCH); auth path now enforces supportedAlgorithms allowlist + pins credential.alg (ALGORITHM_MISMATCH); registration returns credential.alg. SEC-N7: session-token iv/tag/salt length validation. HYG-N3: stored-session expiry re-check. Tests: new tests/authentication/verify-response.test.ts (15) + tests/session/manager.test.ts (2) + token field validation (3); suite 166 -> 186. Gate green (typecheck/lint/build/format).

Spec-compliance & correctness. FUNC-N1/API-N2: userHandle read + validated against credential.webAuthnUserID (USER_HANDLE_MISMATCH) + returned; createRegistrationOptions returns webAuthnUserId. SEC-N4: crossOrigin rejected unless allowCrossOriginIframe (CROSS_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED). FUNC-N2: COSE key === undefined guards + byte-length validation per curve/kty. FUNC-N5: trailing-byte rejection (AUTHENTICATOR_DATA_TRAILING_BYTES). SEC-N5/N6: advisory backupStateChanged/userVerificationDowngraded/counterSupported (WebAuthnCredential.userVerified added). FUNC-N3: optional originVerifier matcher. FUNC-N4: warn when requested attestation isn't trust-anchored. FUNC-N6: isCborParsingError branches on error.code. Tests: new tests/crypto/cose.test.ts (9) + auth additions (8); suite 186 -> 203. Gate green.

Extensions, API surface & hygiene (implemented via a delegated general-purpose sub-agent; diff reviewed + gate re-run in main thread). GAP-N3/HYG-N6: both verify paths return clientExtensionResults; AuthenticationExtensionsClientOutputs modernized (credProps/prf/largeBlob; hmacCreateSecret @deprecated). API-N1: exported open WebAuthnErrorCode union, typed error codes, documented statusCode. GAP-N4: optional excludeCredentials duplicate rejection (CREDENTIAL_ALREADY_REGISTERED) via verifyRegistration 4th param. HYG-N2 honest index.ts banner; HYG-N4 single clientDataJSON decode; HYG-N5 verifyHash delegates to crypto.timingSafeEqual; API-N4 buffersEqual non-security warning; API-N3 session-token encapsulation documented. Tests: new tests/extensions-api.test.ts + tests/utils/hash.test.ts; suite 203 -> 220. Gate green.

Attestation foundation (delegated sub-agent; scope + gate verified in main thread). New src/attestation/: asn1.ts (strict in-house DER reader + findExtension), x509.ts (sync Node X509Certificate chain verification + publicKeyMatchesCOSE, fail-closed), metadata.ts (StaticMetadataService), roots/apple-webauthn-root-ca.ts (REAL Apple WebAuthn Root CA, fetched + openssl-verified), types.ts (Phase 6 contract). src/types/metadata.ts (SYNCHRONOUS MetadataService interface — keeps verifyRegistrationResponse sync, no breaking async). config.metadataService wired; public API exported. Zero new runtime deps. Tests: tests/attestation/{asn1,x509,metadata} (42) + index-exports (3); suite 220 -> 265. Gate green. registration/attestation.ts intentionally untouched (Phase 6 wires it).

Full per-format attestation verification + FIDO MDS (single comprehensive sub-agent for coherence; dispatcher + apple + shared helpers reviewed in main thread; gate re-run). All 6 formats implemented under src/attestation/formats/: apple (bundled-root + nonce + key, trust-anchored w/o MDS), fido-u2f (U2F sig base + chain), packed (self + x5c w/ AAGUID ext + leaf reqs), android-key (KeyDescription challenge ext), tpm (full TPMS_ATTEST/TPMT_PUBLIC parse + AIK), android-safetynet (JWS, deprecated -> Play Integrity). Honest framing: attestationVerified=true ONLY when trust-anchored (apple via bundled root; others via RP metadataService roots); never a false positive; throws only on cryptographically-invalid statements. Dispatcher + verify-response wired; FUNC-N4 requireTrustedAttestation (default false). Tests: tests/attestation/formats/* with a real signed-cert builder, every format has a trust-anchored happy path + negative paths; suite 265 -> 311, zero regressions. Gate green, zero new deps. Caveats for docs: TPM SAN + android-key authz-list not additionally asserted; safetynet needs RP GlobalSign root.

Documentation refresh — three parallel sub-agents on disjoint file sets (A: Readme + SECURITY; B: CHANGELOG + migration; C: api-reference + AI-INTEGRATION-GUIDE + audit-records); instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md at package root, .claude/, and monorepo root) updated in main thread. Every claim verified against real source. README has the honest attestation capability matrix + MetadataService usage + usernameless mini-guide; CHANGELOG [2.3.0] has Upgrade notes; migration 2.2->2.3 added; api-reference covers every new option/field/export with corrected storage-adapter signatures; AI-guide refreshed; audit-records appended; SECURITY.md posture refreshed. All v2.3.0 / 311-tests / 2026-05-29 dates synced. format:check clean; 311 tests still pass (docs-only). Zero source changes.

newFindings: IMPL-1 [info]: The bundled MemoryStorageAdapter already filters expiry inside challenges.find()/sessions.find() (returns null for expired). The new server-side CHALLENGE_EXPIRED + stored-session-expiry checks are therefore defense-in-depth for CUSTOM adapters that don't filter; tested via find()-override stubs.
